palette.notes: Code: 20 colours on the still, one ramp; the 158.6 deg hue shift likely mixes sky and grass. Saturated yellow-green grass, blue sky, grey fence; red and brown on the sprites.

lighting: Bright daylight, sun from upper left; background is painterly and soft-focused so the crisp sprites pop. A fade to black marks the bite.
silhouette: Chunky human hero with backpack, side-on; zombie hunched over the fence. Clear contrasting silhouettes; pistol arm fully extended when aiming.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 16.7 ms and 12.39 changes/s, inflated by the moving camera and blurred background; sprite poses themselves read as a few held frames.

texture: Pixel sprites over a high-res, depth-of-field blurred background (mixed resolution); grass in front is soft and tall, framing the sprites.
camera: Side view; pushes in close for the grab, fades to black, cuts back wide; then a second push for the pistol standoff. Uses letterboxing.

acting.enters: Zombie pops up from behind the fence as the hero walks by; name card 'Zombie McBite-Face' sets up the gag.
acting.acts: Zombie grabs and bites the hero (camera pushes in), fade to black; then the hero tries the pistol and the zombie keeps reaching.
acting.exits: Fade to black after the bite.
acting.depth: Fence and tall grass sit in front of the zombie so it hides and pops out; hero stays mid-ground on the path.

techniques: hide-and-pop entrance from behind foreground cover
camera push-in on the hit, fade to black for the payoff
on-screen action label as joke setup (adventure-game verb text)
crisp sprites over blurred painterly background
repeat the encounter: same zombie, second attempt
feel: crisp sprites on soft blurred bg + hide-behind-fence pop-up + push-in and fade = comic horror beat
for_fred: Let Fred hide behind a foreground object (a rock, a reel caption) and pop out on the punchline; push the camera in on his hit, cut to black, then come back wide for the second try.
